Senses.Explanation: Yuanwu praises the World-Honored One for setting sail with the wind, while Xuedou and other appraisers can use the same sailing skill as a lower, condition-following move. The cases preserve both poles of the sailing idiom: skill in responding to conditions and criticism of action governed only by those conditions.
